premarket.market_expectations: Neutral bias prevails with mixed global cues as Nasdaq futures decline sharply while US yields hover near highs. Domestic institutional buying offsets FII selling, but rupee strength and oil price gains add complexity. The market closed in the bottom third of its recent range yesterday, suggesting caution despite three days of gains. Volatility remains elevated after a recent spike.
